patterns.note: A layered scroll-driven hero transition where an initial full-bleed image scrolls up to reveal a full-bleed video hero, which then scrolls up to reveal the main content grid.
A flexible, multi-column image grid where high-quality photography is the primary content, often accompanied by small, sparse text blocks containing numerical labels or short descriptions.

Consistent and pervasive use of a single monospace font for all textual elements, including navigation, body text, section labels, and numerical identifiers, creating a distinct editorial and archival aesthetic.
A persistent sticky header that includes the site name, navigation links, and a central tagline, all remaining fixed at the top of the viewport during scroll.
Content sections are primarily composed of large-format or full-bleed photography, with text serving a secondary role as captions or metadata rather than driving the narrative.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-driven animation system, likely using locomotive-scroll, to create a layered reveal effect where the initial hero image and subsequent video hero smoothly scroll out of view, revealing the content below.
Content sections and individual grid items appear with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing the sense of discovery and guiding the user's eye.
The header elements, including the site title, navigation, and a central tagline, are fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining constant access and brand presence.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, understated monospace body text (~14px) with slightly larger monospace headings and labels (~16-24px), creating a caption-like feel where text supports large imagery.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a single monospace typeface for almost all textual elements, from navigation to body copy, combined with a scroll-driven layered hero and a minimalist image-grid layout, creates a unique editorial and archival aesthetic. It feels less like a typical marketing site and more like a curated digital exhibition or portfolio, prioritizing visual storytelling with understated textual support.
